title: Colonial Shift & The Alliance
description: British notices have been nailed near the village boundaries. Mekatilili must inspect the proclamation, confront the colonial runner, and plan the resistance circuit with Wanje wa Mwadorikola.

objectives.description: Inspect the colonial proclamation notice posted at the village entry path.
Confront the colonial runner waiting along the boundary path.
Meet with Kaya elder Wanje wa Mwadorikola to plan the resistance circuit.

reward_text: Alliance forged and resistance circuit agreed upon across the Giriama settlements.
